key_insight: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary program search by letting hundreds of agents reason and exchange ideas in latent space rather than generating textual reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Latent-space coordination offers a potentially faster, lower-cost way to optimize programs for mathematical discovery and scientific computing.
method: Run low-cost agent swarms that explore different approaches and communicate through KV caches.
Select distinct ideas using distances between agents’ hidden-state vectors.
Combine swarm members’ KV caches in a summarizer agent to perform latent-space crossover.
evidence_signal: Across 21 problems, SwarmEvolve reports the highest average score and median times of 3–8 minutes to match best scores reached by competing frameworks in 60 minutes.
watch_item: KV-cache sharing requires access to model internals, which may limit deployment through standard hosted-model APIs.
paper_title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
